summary: Targeted frontend bug-fix verification passed on the public preview. All four Project cards expose exactly the required live/source links and primary image/title destinations, with correct href, target='_blank', and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Project 002 remains non-navigating with no href/actions. All four missing images were replaced by numbered gradient placeholders with no broken img remaining. Two fresh preloaders detached in 3.29s and 3.11s, all desktop nav targets landed correctly, both contact toast flows passed, and no console/page errors occurred.
seed_data_creation: None; frontend-only testing and the demo contact form sent no mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend intentionally skipped. Public-preview checks passed: project-001 live/image/title point to https://wealthbuilder.elorasuite.ca/ and Source is absent; project-002 live/source are absent, image/title have no href/target/rel, and clicks preserve the URL; project-003 live/image/title point to https://faithflow.elorasuite.ca/ and Source is absent; project-004 Source/image/title point to https://github.com/seyiiishay/tech-portfolio and View Live is absent. Every external anchor has target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Each lazy missing image transitioned to a numbered radial-gradient fallback with zero img descendants. Fresh preloader timings were 3.29s and 3.11s. Work/About/Skills/Contact nav targets landed at 90px. Empty and valid contact submissions showed the expected error/success toasts, and valid submission cleared all fields. No console errors or uncaught page errors were captured.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior dead-link behavior is resolved by selecting a real primaryUrl (live URL first, then GitHub), conditionally rendering only valid action links, and assigning external-link security attributes. Projects without any real URL retain href-less image/title wrappers whose click guard prevents navigation. Missing image load errors now switch component state to the numbered gradient placeholder.
